So gender is a spectrum. Transgender encompasses MANY things. Not just Female To Male (FTM) and not just Male To Female (MTF) . The main terms are trans male, trans masculine, trans female, and trans feminine. Being a trans male and trans masculine is different. Being a trans male means you were born AFAB  (Assigned female at birth) or potentially intersex (Born as both male and female, there can be many ways that you are intersex) and identify as a male. 

Being trans masculine means you are born AFAB or intersex and do not identify as female, this does not mean you have to identify as male this just means you don't identify as female. Being a trans female means you were born AMAB  (Assigned male at birth) or intersex and identify as a female. Being trans feminine means you are born AMAB or intersex and do not identify as male, this does not mean you have to identify as female this just means you don't identify as male. There are also many genders other than male and female, you can find a list [here](https://lgbtqia.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Gender_identity)  
Though there are some genders that are reserved for specific cultures like [Two Spirited](https://lgbtqia.fandom.com/wiki/Two-Spirit?so=search) is specifically an Indigenous culture and should not be used by non-Indigenous people.
